title: Top 7 Most Bizarre Isekai That Still Work, Ranked
content: Isekai has become one of the biggest genres in the anime industry, and while the basic tenet of many of their stories remains the same, each property can vary wildly from one another based on their premises.

content: Kodansha 's K MANGA service publishes the manga in English and describes the story: Hero, your average high school boy, has a problem: Shio and Akari, his two female childhood friends, go to the same school as him, and they're way too cute!

title: Pokémon Anime Short About Postal Service Dragonite Streams in English
content: The official Pokémon YouTube channel began streaming on Tuesday " Pokémon: Dragonite and the Special Delivery " (" Kairyū to Yūbinya-san ," or Dragonite and the Mailman), an anime short in the Pokémon franchise . The anime centers on Hana, a girl who admires a Dragonite who serves as a postal worker.
author: ANN

title: Giant Killing's Masaya Tsunamoto, Artist Demo Launch New Manga on July 15
content: The June issue of Akita Shoten 's Bessatsu Shōnen Champion magazine revealed on Friday that writer Masaya Tsunamoto and artist Demo will launch a new manga titled Shūgaku Ryokō ~Kyoto・Nara 4-paku 4-nichi (School Trip ~Kyoto・Nara 4 Nights & 4 Days) in the manga's August issue, which will ship on July 15.
author: ANN

title: Another Shonen Jump Series Readies for 2026 Cancellation With New Update
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has already cancelled four series through the year thus far , and it seems like the next series is getting the axe soon as revealed through a new update.

title: Nickelodeon Animator Creates The Perfect Family Guy Crossover
content: While Nickelodeon has had many of its NickToons meet one another in various animated specials, video games, and merchandise, the cable network’s classic characters haven’t explored outside their respective channel too often.

title: Crunchyroll's Net Profit Drops 63% to 453 Million Yen
content: The May 19 issue of the Japanese government's Kanpo gazette reported that Crunchyroll 's net profits for the fiscal period ending in December 2025 were 453 million yen (about US$2.85 million), a drop of 63% from the previously reported 1.239 billion yen (about US$7.79 million) in 2024.
author: ANN

title: Abrams ComicArts' Kana Licenses Tsubonari's Antengai: Twilight Metropolis Manga
content: Abrams ComicArts ' Kana imprint announced on Monday that it has licensed Tsubonari 's Antengai: Twilight Metropolis ( Antengai Gensō Kiroku ) manga, and will begin releasing the manga in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: Voice Actor Tom Kane Dies
content: Kane had suffered a stroke in November 2020, which damaged his ability to speak or write. He retired from voice acting after his stroke. Kane voiced Professor Utonium and HIM in The Powerpuff Girls animated series, though he did not voice the characters in the anime.
author: ANN
